invariants: only a resolved testnet deployment may run the drill
limit-order creation is an EIP-712 signature, not a fabricated on-chain creation transaction
maker and filler are separately validated against their active EIP-1193 provider account and chain
partial fill is strictly positive and less than signed sell amount
fillOrder uses exact signed order, uint128 fill amount, signature, path hash and bounded hop array
fill and cancel each require preflight and canonical finalized receipts
on-chain order hash and exact filledSellAmount are read after fill
only the maker cancels the remaining unfilled amount
on-chain cancelledOrder and preserved filled amount are verified after cancellation
no private key, mnemonic or signature is emitted in live evidence
repository CI never claims an actual live testnet drill occurred
